name: salesforce-account-manager
description: Full-stack Salesforce Account Manager: Vue 3 + TypeScript front end, Node.js/Express + TypeScript API, jsforce OAuth 2.0 client-credentials integration.

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
